info.title: How the service works
info.intro: Tell us your car and we show what actually fits it. Original and analogs in one list, with price and stock at warehouses in Astana. No phone calls, no «send us a photo of the part».

sections.title: Four ways to find a part

items.title: By VIN — the most precise way
items.body: A VIN opens the manufacturer catalog, so we show parts for your exact build, not roughly similar ones. We accept a VIN of any length: on older, Japanese and Korean cars the body number is often shorter than 17 characters. If the VIN is unreadable, pick the make and model by hand.

items.title: Photograph your registration — the VIN fills itself in
items.body: No retyping 17 characters and worrying about O versus 0. Photograph the document right in the browser or add an existing photo from your gallery — the VIN is recognised automatically (on the Kazakh registration it is field No. 5). It copes with glare and with poor light. If one character comes out wrong, fix it without retyping everything.

items.title: By part number
items.body: Know the part number? Enter it. We show the original and analogs available in Astana. If the number does not fit your car, we warn you before you buy, not after.

items.title: By name — or just say it out loud
items.body: Type front brake pads — or tap the button and speak. We match against your car catalog, not by guessing from words: ask for an oil filter and you get the filter, not its bracket.

items.title: The original number (OEM) for your car
items.body: We show the factory number for your specific car, so it is easy to check and hard to get wrong.

items.title: Original and analogs side by side
items.body: One list: the original plus analogs from different makers. You see where you would overpay and where the same thing costs less — the list sorts by price.

items.title: Stock and price right away
items.body: We show what is physically on the shelves in Astana, with quantity and final price. If it is not in the city, we offer to bring it and tell you how long it takes.

items.title: Whether it fits your car
items.body: Every item is marked: fits, compatibility unconfirmed, or not for your car. So you do not buy the wrong thing and drive back to return it.

items.title: Related products
items.body: Below the list — what the same repair usually needs: greases, fasteners, kits. So you do not come back for a small part.

items.title: Express delivery across Astana in 2–4 hours
items.body: Our courier brings it, fee {price} KZT. Order window: {expressHours}.

items.title: Payment after confirmation
items.body: After you order, our manager contacts you, confirms the item and its availability, and takes payment. Nothing to pay upfront.

items.title: All your cars in one place
items.body: Save several cars and switch between them in one tap — every page shows which one the search is for. No more hunting for the VIN.

items.title: Order history
items.body: Past orders stay at hand: repeat any item with one button — no need to search again.
